name: website-deploy-toolkit
description: Plan, build and publish websites on Simple Host (simple-host.app) from a conversation, with a small built-in backend so forms, RSVPs, surveys, votes and orders save and can be read back, and connect a custom domain.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the website you want and it goes online on Simple Host (simple-host.app) at a public address you can share right away: a landing page, a portfolio, an event page, a small shop, a sign-up form or a survey.

Every site comes with a small built-in backend, so the things people submit are saved: RSVPs, survey answers, votes, guestbook entries and orders. Ask for a results or admin page and you get one that lists what was collected. Later you can ask to change a page, see who responded, check how many people visited, roll back to an earlier version, or connect your own domain.

You sign in to Simple Host once (with Google or an emailed code); after that every conversation can publish and update your sites. Pages are public to anyone with the link. Orders, RSVPs and survey answers can go in a private list that only you can read, once the site has its own address (a free name.simple-host.app address takes one step). Simple Host is free.
capabilities: Publish websites at a public address
Edit, rename, roll back and delete your sites
Save form submissions, RSVPs, votes and orders
Read what your sites have collected
defaultPrompt: Build a small shop page for my homemade pickles, with an order form and a page that lists the orders
Make a beautiful RSVP page for my garden party on October 12, with an admin page showing who is coming
Create a customer feedback survey with a results page that tallies the answers
